data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 30/0835Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL DEPRESSION NINETEEN HOLDS STEADY SHIFTING EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD. As of 2:00 AM PDT Wed Sep 30 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 13.6, -129.4 with movement ESE at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/0842Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA EXPECTED TO BECOME A REMNANT LOW BY TONIGHT. As of 9:00 AM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.5, -43.9 with movement ESE at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Rachel (EP3), advisory 30/1134Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL CONTINUES MOVING NORTHWESTWARD. ...COULD BECOME A MAJOR HURRICANE IN A DAY OR SO... As of 5:00 AM MST Wed Sep 30 the center of Rachel was located near 17.8, -107.6 with movement NW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 979 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 85 mph.

data.title: Remnants of Polo (EP2), advisory 30/1148Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO DISSIPATES OVER NORTHWESTERN MEXICO. As of 8:00 PM MST Tue Sep 29 the center of Polo was located near 30.5, -108.0 with movement NE at 23 mph. The minimum central pressure was 996 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
